This episode takes us into the making of Bihar’s famous Katarni chura, made from GI-tagged Katarni rice, before we head out on a food trail through some of Bhagalpur’s much-loved local spots.
We began by visiting a Katarni chura factory to see how this traditional rice preparation is made. The process is painstaking and time-consuming, with several stages involved before the rice is transformed into the delicate, flattened chura we know. Seeing the amount of work that goes into something so familiar was fascinating.
